newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up on tight supplies, new demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up on tight supplies, new demand.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were offered higher on tight supplies and an unexpected increase in demand from shippers, traders said.
They said 380-cst bunker supplies were offered at about $105/$106 per tonne and the 180-cst grade was around $2.50 more.
"There is a bit of a squeeze on the market right now. 380-cst is very very tight and there are enquiries from people I've not heard from for a long time," one supplier said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated around $173 and $180 per tonne respectively.
